purpose.summary: Batch program that processes receipt (medical claim) detail files for hospitalization/outpatient transfers and self-pay cases. It reads from an indexed receipt master file (RECE83), transforms/filters records based on system control parameters (e.g., transfer date flag SYS-2005-TENKIHENKBN), and writes output to a new indexed receipt detail file (RECE831). It also handles job management (start/stop/cancel) and error file output.
